global_limits: This packet records actual merged PR23 checks at 6222a745195e9f15a14069e79210ad45daa16c94. Relative evidence paths resolve inside this postmerge packet. Candidate and prior failures remain at the separate immutable predecessor.
Already-merged predecessor PR references identify reused implementation/context, not proof that the entire criterion is satisfied. Current integration commits are not labelled merged predecessors.
Only #6 is potentially closable after actual exact merged checks and independent review. #7/#9/#11–#15 and gate #5 remain open for missing evidence; epic #4 closes only after gate acceptance.
#8 and #10 being closed on GitHub does not supply missing appointments, identity decisions, provenance, font strategy, release acceptance or consumer ACKs.
@CompleteDotTech is a nominated accountable approver, not a recorded approval. Technical/export, rights and required consumer reviewers still need actual appointments/acknowledgments.
Existing user constraint forbids self-hosted font delivery. TTFs remain source-only for logo outline generation; external-hosted policy/availability/privacy/fallback evidence is pending.
Mock/synthetic fixtures, offline review archives, contact sheets and font-fallback/type-enlargement proxies remain labelled local evidence. Required missing cases are not passes.

Normal release/provenance/package/consumer checks remain blocked on actual missing inputs. Provider receipts are recorded separately from what the offline invocation performed and require independent authentication.
PR #3 is not fully superseded: PR #22 merged valid immutable links, while paper-only app direction, foil material rules and sound changes require accountable owner decisions.
Canonical interfaces remain with shared-contracts, app assembly with getticketstub.com and master acceptance with integration-evals. No foreign/global gate or deployment is completed by this map.

BK-09 closure needs named Product/Landing/Marketing early interface review of the exact producer artifact/local fixtures only; completed consumer implementation/release/tested pins are not prerequisites.

Master P0 demonstration/financial-integrity, P1 expansion and Production-before-live-commerce priorities govern; local labels do not override them. No external publication/provider request/credential provisioning is authorized by this map.

Coverage is 74 leaf/gate rows (55 leaf criteria plus 19 gate rows), plus 11 separately mapped epic dependency pointers. The epic pointers are not 11 additional independent acceptance criteria. The earlier shorthand "all 74 issue checkboxes" did not include epic #4.

The gate ran before recording BK-01 closure. Its 29 missing decision/command blockers are retained verbatim, including the unfilled BK-01 distribution-artifact receipt slot. Scoped issue closure does not fabricate an approval ledger entry against a still-unselected release artifact.
